title.en: The settings provided by the manufacturer of the electrosurgical unit should be favored, tailored to the specific type of knife and coagulation forceps being used.

statement.en: The settings provided by the manufacturer of the electrosurgical unit should be favored, tailored to the specific type of knife and coagulation forceps being used.

commentary.en: Only one retrospective study, encompassing 1826 patients, has explored the influence of electrosurgical energy settings on POEM outcomes. In a secondary and multivariable analysis, the authors observed that using a current mode other than spray coagulation for myotomy or tunneling was associated with a heightened incidence of AEs (odds ratio [OR] 3.09; P = 0.02) [13]. The choice of electrosurgical unit settings typically hinges on factors such as the brand and model of the electrosurgical unit, the type of knife employed, and the operator’s preferences.
